minutes.headline: Building committee's charge widened to all town buildings; chair Roy will step down and the vote on a new chair waits for the next meeting.
minutes.summary: The committee discussed its new charge from the Select Board, which expands it from the TC Passios renovation to town space needs across several buildings. Members debated the clause on making statements on behalf of the committee and the lack of a defined deliverable. The chair announced he will step down as chair, the Finance Committee representative expects to leave, and reorganization was deferred to the next meeting on February 7.

public_comment.topic: Call for public comment at the start; a committee member raised the question of who takes minutes and whether a minutes clerk is in place.
A caller named Rhonda was invited to speak; she said she had no comment and was only listening.

Peter spoke on the Mossman gift used for the teen center, urged the committee to get financial parameters for the next decade from town officials, and proposed buying the property in front of the public safety building for a modest municipal office building.

votes.motion: Motion to adjourn, taken by roll call
votes.outcome: Roll call recorded; each member named answered yes or aye, but the captions garble part of it

budget_items.topic: Cost of the TC Passios new build and a possible cap
budget_items.what_was_said: A select board member said the new build cost approached a figure the town cannot afford, and a smaller solution would also be unaffordable. He said the combined solution must stay under a cap of around twenty million.
The town manager's ten-year capital plan will be presented next meeting. The cap would be set by the select board or town manager's office.

budget_items.topic: Funding for architects or professional support
budget_items.what_was_said: A member asked how the committee could fund architectural work. Others said professional support would be needed and the select board may seek town meeting funding.

budget_items.topic: Alternative property purchase and revenue ideas
budget_items.what_was_said: A select board member suggested buying a former church property and said the town needs revenue, including solar on the old town dump, to offset senior tax relief.

budget_items.topic: Mossman gift funding for the teen center
budget_items.what_was_said: A member said the teen center was built with a gift earmarked for agricultural education and urged that this be considered if the building is reused.

decisions.decision: Reorganization of the committee and election of a new chair deferred to the next meeting, pending the Finance Committee's appointment of a representative.
Members will email the chair their thoughts on a roadmap before the next meeting; the next agenda will include discussion of a roadmap/outline.
Next meeting set for Monday February 7 at 5:30 by Zoom.
The chair will remain on the committee as a citizen member but step down as chair at the next meeting.

what_happened.line: The chair said he will step down as chair at the next meeting but stay on as a citizen member.
Reorganization and the election of a new chair were deferred to the next meeting, pending the Finance Committee naming a representative.
The committee reviewed a new charge from the Select Board that widens its scope from the TC Passios renovation to town space needs across several buildings.
A Select Board member said the combined solution must stay under a cap of around twenty million; the cap would be set by the Select Board or town manager's office.
Members will email the chair thoughts on a roadmap, and the next meeting is set for Monday, February 7, at 5:30 by Zoom.

why_it_matters: The committee that will recommend what the town does with its municipal buildings now covers several buildings, not one, and has no chair or defined deliverable yet.
A spending cap and a ten-year capital plan, both set outside the committee, will bound the options, and any architectural work may need funding from a Town Meeting vote.
